lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows across the visible mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, showing a distinct luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal-facing edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 5-7 high-luminance spots are distributed across the posterior and basal regions of the first dorsal fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, dark-pigmented commensal organisms (Echeneidae) are visible attached near the dorsal fin and trailing the ventral flank.
